arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Mizer argued the case belongs in state court.
He cited comity and federalism principles.
Mr. Fitch addressed standing concerns raised by the Court.
Justices questioned the complexity of the state law analysis.

paragraphs: Ohio taxes natural gas suppliers. The suppliers claim the rates violate federal law. The state argues federal courts must abstain.
